tags.name: The Spoon
tags.description: The Spoon is the small Black bowl just to the right (looking downhill) of Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this bowl from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).

tags.name: Cougar Chutes
tags.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.

tags.name: Cougar Chutes
tags.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.

tags.name: So Sweet
tags.description: So Sweet is a short Black glade area that starts on the Green Line Connector (Green) at the bottom of the Blackcomb Terrain Park, crosses Connector (Green) and ends on Slingshot (Blue).

tags.name: Strawline
tags.description: Strawline is a short blue that runs below Upper Green Line over to end on Cruiser.

tags.name: Cruiser Bumps
tags.description: Cruiser Bumps is short Black mogul run that starts on the left side of Cruiser, runs parallel to Cruiser and then ends back on the side of Cruiser.

tags.name: Cruiser Bumps
tags.description: Cruiser Bumps is short Black mogul run that starts on the left side of Cruiser, runs parallel to Cruiser and then ends back on the side of Cruiser.

tags.name: Stoker Bumps
tags.description: Stoker Bumps is a short Black mogul run that starts on the right side of Ross’s Gold (Blue) and runs down to Greenline (Green).

tags.name: Buzz Cut
tags.description: Buzz Cut is medium wide Blue with some steeper sections that runs from Wishbone (Blue), past the top of the Excelerator Express Chairlift and then down to Greenline (Green).

tags.name: Zig Zag
tags.description: Zig Zag is a medium wide Blue with some steep sections that starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (near the bottom of the Excelerator Express Chairlift).

tags.name: Crosscut
tags.description: Crosscut is a Green cat track run from the top of the Excelerator Express Chairlift over to the Glacier Creek Lodge area.

tags.name: Gnarly Knots
tags.description: Gnarly Knots is a short Black glade area that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Honeycomb (Blue), runs parallel to Espresso (Blue) and then ends on Espresso.

tags.name: Stoker Bumps
tags.description: Stoker Bumps is a short Black mogul run that starts on the right side of Ross’s Gold (Blue) and runs down to Greenline (Green).

tags.name: Crystal Glide
tags.description: Crystal Glide is the lower access route into the Crystal Ridge area.  This Blue run starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and continues down to the bottom of the Crystal Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Cruiser Bumps
tags.description: Cruiser Bumps is short Black mogul run that starts on the left side of Cruiser, runs parallel to Cruiser and then ends back on the side of Cruiser.

tags.name: Honey Bee
tags.description: Honey Bee is a short Blue that runs down from the top of the Excelerator Express Chairlift down to Honeycomb.

tags.name: Strawline
tags.description: Strawline is a short blue that runs below Upper Green Line over to end on Cruiser.

tags.name: Honeycomb
tags.description: Honeycomb is medium wide Blue that starts on Wishbone just past where Cruiser (Blue) starts.  It runs parallel to Cruiser down the frontside and ends where the Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) and Greenline (Green) meet just above the bottom Excelerator.

tags.name: Catskinner Traverse
tags.description: Catskinner Traverse is a Green cat track run from the top the Excelerator Express Chairlift across the Blackcomb Upper Frontside over to the bottom of the Catskinner Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Come a Long
tags.description: Come a Long is a Green cat track run that starts on the side of Zig Zag near the Glacier Creek Lodge and runs diagonally down the Blackcomb Upper Front Side area to end on Green Line where it crosses Cruiser.

tags.name: Race Center
tags.description: The Race Center is fenced of portion of Cougar Milk (Blue)  which has a small ski race course on it.   It runs down the left Cougar Milk (looking downhill) and ends on the right Wally's World.

tags.name: Jersey Cream Race Center
tags.description: The Race Center is fenced of portion of Cougar Milk (Blue)  which has a small ski race course on it.   It runs down the left Cougar Milk (looking downhill) and ends on the right Wishbone (Blue) run.

tags.name: Jersey Cream
tags.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Cougar Milk Connector
tags.description: Cougar Connector is a short Blue connector run between Jersey Cream and Cougar Milk.

tags.name: Wishbone
tags.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It gets its name because it splits into 2 runs (like a chicken wishbone) around several forest “islands”.

tags.name: Buzz Cut Connecter
tags.description: Buzz Cut Connector is a short Blue that runs from Wally's World over to the top of the the Excelerator Express Chairlift and the start of Buzz Cut.

tags.name: Jersey Cream
tags.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Wally World
tags.description: Wally's World is a Blue that runs from the Jersey Cream Run, runs parallel to Wishbone and ends and the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: The Bite
tags.description: The Bite is the most difficult steep Black big mogul run from Coyote Road down to the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift base.   This run is recognizable for the very large boulder in the middle of the lower half of the run.

tags.name: Staircase
tags.description: Staircase is a steep, challenging Black big mogul run that comes down from Coyote Road and ends on Wishbone (Blue).

tags.name: Bagger 1
tags.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).

tags.name: Bagger 2
tags.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).

tags.name: Bagger 3
tags.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).

tags.name: Rock N'Roll - Upper
tags.description: Rock’n’Roll - Upper starts on the right side of Trapline - Upper and runs down to join Backstage pass further downhill.

tags.name: Ridge Runner
tags.description: Ridge Runner is one of the main Blues that runs from the top of the Crystal Express Chairlift down through the Crystal Ridge area and ends on Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue).

tags.name: Davies Dervish
tags.description: Davies Dervish is a steep, wide Black mogul run the starts on Blue Line (Blue) and then continues down to the Glacier Express Chairlift base area.

tags.name: Backstage Pass
tags.description: Backstage Pass is medium wide Blue with some steep sections.   Normally groomed, it can also offer some nice fresh tracks on a new snow day.  It starts on the right side of Rock’n’Roll (Blue), runs parallel with it and then curves off to the right to join

tags.name: Upper Straight Shot
tags.description: Upper Straight Shot is a Black mogul runs that start from Crystal Road (Green) just below the Crystal Hut.  It runs parallel to White Light (Blue) and ends on Blueline (Blue).

tags.name: Dave's Day Off
tags.description: Dave’s Day Off is a bumpy, off-piste Black run that goes down the middle of Brownlie Bowl (Black).

tags.name: Overbite
tags.description: Overbite is a long, steep, wide Black mogul run the starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), runs down to and crosses Blue Line (Blue) and then continues down to the Glacier Express Chairlift base area.

tags.name: Lower Straight Shot
tags.description: Lower Straight Shot is a Blue run that starts on Blue Line (Blue), runs down to cross Blue Line further down the mountain and Crystal Road (Green) and then ends at the bottom near the end of Trapline (Blue).

tags.name: White Light
tags.description: White Light is a Blue mogul run with some steep sections.  It starts just below the top of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift, crosses Blue Line (Blue) and Crystal Road (Green) and ends below Crystal Glide (Blue).

tags.name: Blue Line
tags.description: Blue Line starts at the top of the ridge behind Horstman Hut curves down into the Horstman Glacier Bowl, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and then curves down and behind the Glacier Creek Lodge.

tags.name: Cougar Milk
tags.description: Cruiser is steep-ish Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Wishbone (Blue) and then curves to the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Smoked Salmon
tags.description: Smoked Salmon is a short, steep Black glade run that starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), curves down through the trees and ends on Blueline (Blue).

tags.name: Side Bottom
tags.description: Mellow and slightly gladed moguls beneath Fraggle Rock, labelled "Lower Fraggle Rock" on a sign at the main entrance from Rock N' Roll

tags.name: Wally World
tags.description: Wally's World is a Blue that runs from the Jersey Cream Run, runs parallel to Wishbone and ends and the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Wishbone
tags.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Zig Zag
tags.description: Zig Zag is a medium wide Blue with some steep sections that starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (near the bottom of the Excelerator Express Chairlift).

tags.name: Rider's Revenge
tags.description: Rider’s Revenge is a short Black glade run.  It starts on the right side of Crystal Road (Green) near the end of Trapline (Blue) and ends down on Crystal Glide (Blue).

tags.name: Fraggle Rock
tags.description: Fraggle Rock is a steep, unmarked area that runs down the face of a small summit underneath and near the top of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.  It starts from Rock’n’Roll (Blue) and requires a short hike or skate to get up the back of the summit.

tags.name: Blackcomb Glacier Road - Lower
tags.description: Blackcomb Glacier Road - Lower is a Green cat track that runs from the bottom of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift over to the bottom of the Excelerator Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Rock N'Roll - Lower
tags.description: Rock’n’Roll - Lower starts at the bottom of Rock'n'Roll - Upper and continues down to end on Crystal Ride.   This section of Rock'n'Roll is not groomed.

tags.name: Twist and Shout
tags.description: Twist & Shout is a short Blue with steep sections that runs from the right side of Ridge Runner and ends on Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue).

tags.name: Arthur's Choice
tags.description: Arthur’s Choice is a bumpy Black glade run that starts on the right side of Ridge Runner (Blue) and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Drive (Blue).

tags.name: Outer Limits
tags.description: Outer Limits is a difficult, steep, bumpy Black glade run with tighter trees and big bumps.   It starts on the right side of Ridge Runner (Blue) and goes down through a forest fire burnt forest and ends on Blackcomb Glacier Drive (Blue).

tags.name: Log Jam
tags.description: Log Jam is a short Black glade run that goes through a section of burnt trees.  It starts on the right side of Crystal Road (Green) and runs down either to exit on the left onto Backstage Pass (Blue) or on the right onto Ridge Runner (Blue).

tags.name: Log Jam
tags.description: Log Jam is a short Black glade run that goes through a section of burnt trees.  It starts on the right side of Crystal Road (Green) and runs down either to exit on the left onto Backstage Pass (Blue) or on the right onto Ridge Runner (Blue).

tags.name: Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift Run
tags.description: Underneath the lower half of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift there is an unmarked run with several steep, difficult sections and cliff faces (Double Black level in spots).  It starts on Rock’n’roll (Blue) and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue)

tags.name: Lost Crew
tags.description: Lost Crew trail is nordic backcountry trail. The trail is cleared but not groomed and only infrequently marked with flagging tape. Flagging is better near the east end, nonexistent at the west end.

tags.note: I think this is an old Canadian Wilderness Adventures snowmobile trail that is no longer used for that purpose

tags.name: Cowboy Left
tags.description: Cowboy Ridge's skier's left line.

tags.name: Sluiceway
tags.description: Sluiceway is a short Blue run that starts on the side of Cloud Nine and exits back on to Cloud Nine further down the hill.

tags.name: Xhiggy's Meadow
tags.piste:name: Xhiggy's Meadow
tags.description: Xhiggy’s Meadow is a steep, bumpy Black slope just below the start of the Lakeside Bowl Traverse and to the left of Cloud Nine (Blue).  Exit out of the bottom of Xhiggy’s is on to Cloud Nine.

tags.name: Lakeside Traverse
tags.description: The Lakeside Traverse is a long traverse under the cliffs, across the top of the Lakeside Bowl.  It provides access to a variety of routes into the bowl.

tags.name: Lakeside Bowl
tags.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.

tags.name: Lakeside Bowl
tags.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.

tags.name: Lakeside Bowl
tags.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.

tags.name: Showcase
tags.description: Showcase is a wide, steep Blue that runs down from the top of the Showcase T-Bar, down the upper middle of the Horstman Glacier and then ends on Crystal Traverse (Blue) at the bottom of the Showcase T-bar.

tags.name: Horstman Face
tags.description: Horstman Face is a steep, challenging Double Black that drops down behind the Horstman Hut into the Glacier Express Chairlift area.

tags.name: Pakalolo
tags.piste:name: Pakalolo
tags.description: Pakalolo is steep, bumpy Double Black that starts with a chute at the top just below Secret Bowl and turns into a steep mogul field that leads down to Blue Line (Blue).

tags.name: Garnet Bowl Right
tags.description: Garnet Bowl right is the route to skiers' right (looking downhill) of Garnet Bowl.  It provides access the Sapphire Bowl Entrance Chutes as well as a traverse into Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Hawaii 5-0
tags.description: Hawaii 5-0 is an extremely steep, curved Triple Black chute that leads into Saudan Couloir.  Entrance to “5-0” (as the locals call it) into the top of the chute is over a cornice along the edge of Chainsaw Ridge (Black).

tags.name: Secret Bowl Traverse
tags.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.

tags.name: Bushrat
tags.description: Bushrat is steep, challenging Triple Black chute into the Saudan Couloir between Hawaii 5-0 (Triple Black) and Bushwip (Triple Black) along the side Chainsaw Ridge (Black).  The entrance into this chute is from Chainsaw ridge and then over a cornice.

tags.name: Bushrat Shoulder
tags.description: Bushrat Shoulder is steep, challenging Triple Black that runs parallel to and just below Bushrat.  The entrance from Chainsaw Ridge (Black) is the same as Bushrat, but then Bushrat Shoulder runs along a bench between the cliffs below Bushrat.

tags.name: Whiplash
tags.description: Whiplash is a Triple Black entrance into the Saudan Couloir   Entrance is over a cornice which then leads down into a steep, rocky chute down into the Bowl.

tags.name: Bushwip
tags.description: Bushwip is a Triple Black chute into the Saudan Couloir below.  The entrance into this run is from Chainsaw Ridge and over a cornice down into a steep, rocky chute.

tags.name: Pipeline
tags.description: Pipeline is steep, narrow, rocky Double Black chute (located halfway between Secret Bowl and Pakalolo) that then curves down under a cliff to end on the mogul field below Pakalolo (Double Black).

tags.name: The Curl / Lone Pine
tags.description: The Curl / Lone Pine is a steep, narrow Triple Black that starts on the side of Secret Bowl and runs down a bench underneath a cliff to the wall above Blue Line (Blue).

tags.name: Swiss Cheese
tags.description: Swiss Cheese is steep Black run that runs diagonally down the face below the top part of Secret Bowl.   It starts at the top from Secret Bowl and then runs down to end on Blueline (Blue).

tags.name: Garnet Bowl
tags.description: The Garnet Bowl is the small Black bowl immediate below the top of Spanky’s Ladder and above Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Garnet Bowl Center
tags.description: Garnet Bowl Centre is the Black route down the middle / center of Garnet Bowl.  It provides access to the main entrance into Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Garnet Bowl Left
tags.piste:name: Garnet Bowl
tags.description: Garnet Bowl Left is a Black route through the left side (looking downhill) of Garnet Bowl.   It provides access to the left entrance into Diamond Bowl as well as runs into Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Ruby Bowl Traverse
tags.description: The Ruby Bowl Traverse is a long traverse along the ridge above Ruby Bowl.   It provides access to Spanky's Chute (Double Black) which leads down into Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Upper Green Line
tags.description: Upper Green Line is the Green that runs from the top of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift, zig zags down the front of this area and then exits to the right towards the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Teetering
tags.description: Teetering is a very steep, challenging Triple Black Chute that  comes down from Secret Bowl into the Glacier Express Chairlift area.   It is named for the large rock that is "teetering" on the edge of the cliff next to it.

tags.name: Showcase Bowl
tags.description: Showcase Bowl is the alpine bowl on either side of Showcase run.

tags.name: Secret Bowl Run
tags.piste:name: Secret Chute
tags.description: Secret Bowl run is steep, wide Black mogul run that comes out of Secret Bowl through an opening in the cliff face and then runs down to Blueline (Blue) below.

tags.name: False Face
tags.description: False Face is an extremely steep Triple Black face that drops into the Saudan Couloir to the left of the Saudan Couloir run.

tags.name: Sunrise Traverse
tags.description: Sunrise Traverse is a narrow, rocky and dangerous Double Black traverse that goes from the right side of Quasar (Black) over to the top of a cliff to the top of Sunrise Chute (Double Black).

tags.name: Sunrise Chute
tags.description: Sunrise Chute is a narrow, steep, rocky Double Black chute accessible at the top from Sunrise Traverse (Triple Black).

tags.name: Upper Feathertree
tags.description: Upper Feather Tree is a steep, rocky Double Black face on the right side of the Saudan Couloir that leads down into the upper end of couloir.

tags.name: Lower Feather Tree Traverse
tags.description: Lower Feather Tree is the steep, wide slope on the right side of the lower side of the Saudan Couloir and above the Jersey Cream Bowl.   You can access Upper Feather Tree (Double Black) via a traverse on the right 1/3rd the way down Quasar (Double Black).

tags.name: Clean Out
tags.description: Clean Out is a short, steep Black chute entrance into the side of Secret Bowl Run (Black).  It starts at the top from Secret Bowl and ends on Secret Bowl Run.

tags.name: Sylvain / Big Bang
tags.piste:name: Sylvain / Big Bang
tags.description: Quasar is the the easier (but still challenging), steep Black route down into the Saudan Couloir.  It starts to the right of the Saudan Couloir (Double Black), curves to the right side of the moraine and ends in the top of the Jersey Cream Bowl.

tags.name: Showcase Traverse
tags.description: Showcase Traverse runs across the bottom end of the Horstman Glacier from the bottom of Horstman over to Crystal Traverse.

tags.name: Glacier Drive
tags.description: Glacier Drive is Black that starts behind Horstman Hut, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and ends down at the bottom of the chairlift next to the Glacier Creek Lodge.   The top part of this run used to be called Blue Line.

tags.name: Blackcomb Glacier Traverse
tags.description: The Blackcomb Glacier Traverse runs across the top of the Blackcomb Glacier and provides access to runs into the bowl as well to routes at the far East end that exit the area (e.g. the Spearhead Traverse).

tags.name: Blow Hole
tags.description: The Blowhole is a famous, unique Black feature on the left side of the glacier.  It gets its shape from the winds howling over the ridge and looks like a long halfpipe.

tags.name: Wind Lip
tags.description: The Wind Lip is an ungroomed Black that leads down the right side (looking downhill) of the glacier and ends in the bottom of the bowl.

tags.name: Winky Pop
tags.description: Winky Pop is a short Black that goes over a rock ledge below Surf’s Up.  Winky Pop is accessible by traversing to the left (looking downhill) below and the Blow Hole (Black).

tags.name: Surf's Up
tags.description: Surf’s Up is a narrow, steep, difficult Double Black chute accessible from left side (looking downhill) of Winky Pop (Black).

tags.name: Low Entry
tags.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.

tags.name: Sapphire Chutes
tags.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below

tags.name: Sapphire Chutes
tags.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below

tags.name: Sapphire Chutes
tags.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below

tags.name: Family Jewels
tags.description: Family Jewels is a steep Double Black that runs down the left side (looking downhill) of Sapphire Bowl and exits down on to Blackcomb Glacier (Blue).

tags.name: Zut Zut
tags.description: Zut Zut is challenging Double Black that starts from the left side of Family Jewels (Double Black), curves down to the left (looking downhill) and runs diagonally down across a bench between cliffs above and below.  It exits into Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Blackcomb Glacier
tags.description: Blackcomb Glacier is a large, wide glacial bowl with a Blue route that runs down the middle to the Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) at the bottom.

tags.name: Main Entry
tags.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.

tags.name: 2M Gully
tags.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.

tags.name: Double Rubble
tags.description: Double Rubble is an advanced chute accessible via the Sapphire Traverse. This run has some major exposure so be careful.

tags.name: Sapphire Traverse
tags.description: Large Traverse from the Blowhole exit into Sapphire Bowl. Section of traverse above Double Rubble and Surf's Up is a no fall zone with extreme exposure. Follow the bottom of the permanently closed area to the top of Sapphire Bowl.

tags.name: Dakine
tags.description: Dakine is a Black mogul field below the Glacier Express Chairlift.  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Crystal Traverse, goes down under the chairlift and then runs down parallel to Blue Line.

tags.name: Brownlie Basin
tags.description: Brownlie Basin is a bumpy, cone shaped Black bowl below Crystal Traverse (Blue) that ends down on Blue Line (Blue).  You can drop into this Bowl at various points along the edge of Crystal Traverse.

tags.name: Don't Stop
tags.description: Don’t Stop is a short, steep Black glade run that is a sibling to Smoked Salmon (Black).  This run also starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), curves down through the trees and ends on Smoked Salmon.

tags.name: Dakine
tags.description: Dakine is a Black mogul field below the Glacier Express Chairlift.  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Crystal Traverse, goes down under the chairlift and then runs down parallel to Blue Line.

tags.name: Chimney Ladder Taverse
tags.description: The Chimney Ladder is a lesser known and used boot hike  to get up on the ridge above Crystal Traverse (Blue).  You can access the bottom of this ladder by following the Chimney Ladder Traverse above Crystal Traverse (Blue).

tags.name: Chimney Ladder
tags.description: The Chimney Ladder is a lesser known and used boot hike  to get up on the ridge above Crystal Traverse (Blue).  You can access the bottom of this ladder by following the Chimney Ladder Traverse above Crystal Traverse (Blue).

tags.name: Spanky's Chute
tags.description: Spanky’s Chute is a challenging, steep, narrow Double Black chute that leads into the top of Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Ruby Bowl Traverse
tags.piste:name: Ruby Bowl Traverse
tags.description: Traverse across the top of Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Ruby Bowl
tags.piste:name: Ruby Bowl
tags.description: Ruby Bowl is a big, steep, bumpy Double Black bowl.   To access Ruby Bowl, traverse left across from the top of Spanky’s Ladder and then take either Spanky’s Shoulder (Black) or Spanky’s Chute (Double Black) into Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Grey Zone
tags.description: The Grey Zone is a Black area of ungroomed, rocky open alpine above Crystal Traverse (Blue).   It starts at the top of the Chimney Ladder and runs down to the top of Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Grey Zone
tags.description: The Grey Zone is a Black area of ungroomed, rocky open alpine above Crystal Traverse (Blue).   It starts at the top of the Chimney Ladder and runs down to the top of Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.

tags.name: CBC Trees
tags.description: CBC Trees is an unmarked Double Black glade area below Ridge Runner (Blue).  The entrance into this area is by a traverse from the right side near the top of Ridge Runner and the exit is on to Outer Limits (Double Black).

tags.name: Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter)
tags.description: Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter) is the 2nd entrance into Diamond Bowl and is a narrow chute above the large cliff on the left side (looking downhill) of the bowl.

tags.name: Playland
tags.description: Playland is a tight, steep Double Black gully that runs down below a cliff along the right side (looking downhill) of Ruby Bowl.   You can access Playland by going right below the cliffs at the bottom of Skid Lips (Double Black).

tags.name: Skid Lips
tags.piste:name: Skid Lips
tags.description: Skid Lips is a steep Double Black that runs along the shoulder of a cliff along the right side of Ruby Bowl below Spanky’s Shoulder (Double Black).

tags.name: Shredder
tags.piste:name: Shredder
tags.description: Shredder is a steep Double Black and is the furthest left route (looking downhill) down Ruby Bowl.

tags.name: Midway Rock
tags.piste:name: Midway Rock
tags.description: Midway Rock a steep Double Black route down the left side (looking downhill) of Ruby Bowl.  It is named after the Midway Rock cliff face that runs across the middle of Ruby Bowl.
Diamond Bowl is a large, steep, bumpy, ungroomed alpine bowl that then leads down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) below

tags.name: Diamond Bowl
tags.description: Diamond Bowl is the lower, middle of 3 Gemstone Bowls.  It sits directly below Garnet Bowl (which is directly below the Spanky’s Ladder entrance into this area).

tags.name: Wild Thing
tags.description: Wild Thing is a steep Double Black chute entrance down the cliffs on the right side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Hobbs (Left)
tags.description: Hobbs is actually 2 separate rocky Double Black chutes that go down through a lower cliff face on the left side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Hobbs (Right)
tags.description: Hobbs is actually 2 separate rocky Double Black chutes that go down through a lower cliff face on the left side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Calvin
tags.description: Calvin is a short Double Black face below the Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Double Black).  You can access the top of Calvin traversing and climbing up to the left just below the narrow Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter) into Diamond Bowl.

tags.name: Bad Attitude
tags.piste:name: Bad Attitude
tags.description: Bad Attitude is an extremely difficult, Triple Black chute (with a very fitting name) that leads down to a sloping bench between big cliffs above and below.  It is accessible via a very difficult, rocky traverse from the top of Clavin (Double Black).

tags.name: Bad Attitude Traverse
tags.description: Bad Attitude Traverse is a very difficult, rocky traverse from the top of Calvin (Double Black) to the start of Bad Attitude (Triple Black).

tags.name: Diamond Centre
tags.description: The Diamond Bowl Main Entrance is the central entrance down from Garnet Bowl into the Diamond Bowl below.  This entrance is a steep, rocky chute, approach with caution.

tags.name: Diamond Bowl
tags.description: Diamond Bowl is a large, steep, bumpy, ungroomed alpine bowl that then leads down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) below

tags.name: Back in Time
tags.description: Back in Time is a long, narrow Blue that curves down the North side of Mount Morrisey.  It starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift and runs down to Sun Peaks Road.  You can cross the road to get to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Tumble Dry
tags.description: Tumble Dry is a steep, bumpy Black that starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift and runs down to the end of the Fairways Ski Back (Green).

tags.name: In Tatters
tags.description: In Tatters is steep, difficult Double Black mogul run that starts on Tumble Dry (Black) and runs down to Fairways Ski Back (Green).  NOTE:  Given that this run ends on the Fairways Ski-Back, it exits out to Burfield base.

tags.name: Lint Trap
tags.description: Lint Trap is a steep, bumpy Black that starts on Back in Time (Blue) and runs down to Tumble Dry (Black).

tags.name: Static Cling Return
tags.description: Static Cling Return is a short, narrow Black that cuts across the Black and Double Black runs on the East side of Mount Morrisey.  It starts on Tumble Dry (Black) and ends on Static Cling (Double

tags.name: The Sticks
tags.description: The Sticks is a long Green that starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift, runs along the Western edge of the Mount Morrisey area and ends at the bottom of the Morrisey Express Chairlift.

tags.name: CC Riders
tags.description: CC Riders is a winding Blue that starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift, curves down under the chairlift line and ends on Telly Gram (Blue).   This run has multiple paths that go around small islands of trees.

tags.name: I’Dunno
tags.description: I’Dunno is a long Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of The Sticks (Green), curves down through the West side of Mount Morrisey and ends on Still’Smokin (Blue).

tags.name: Grand Return
tags.description: Grand Return is the long Blue that runs down from the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift down to the Village base footbridge exit.   This is the most direct exit route from the Morrisey area to the Village.

tags.name: Mid-Life Crisis
tags.description: Mid-Life Crisis is a long Blue that runs down the left side (looking downhill) of the Morrisey Express Chairlift.  It starts at the top of the chairlift and runs down to Anticipation (Green) which then goes to the bottom of the Morrisey Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Second Growth
tags.description: Similar to Out of the Woods (Blue), Second Growth is another long, narrow Blue that runs down through the glades on the West side of Mount Morrisey and ends down on The Sticks (Green)

tags.name: Showboat
tags.description: Showboat is a long, straight Blue that starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift, runs underneath the chairlift and ends at the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Static Cling
tags.description: Similar to In Tatters (Double Black) Static Cling is very steep, difficult Double Black mogul run that starts on Grand Return (Blue) and runs down to end on the Fairways Ski Back (Green).

tags.name: Still Smokin'
tags.description: Still’Smokin is a long Blue that starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift, runs down through the glades on the West side of Mount Morrisey and ends on The Sticks (Green) just above the bottom of the Morrisey Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Out of the Woods
tags.description: Out of the Woods is a short, narrower Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of I’Dunno (Blue) and runs down to The Sticks (Green).

tags.name: Telly Gram
tags.description: Telly Gram is Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Still’Smokin and runs down through the glades to the the Morrisey Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: 5 Mile
tags.description: 5 Mile is a long (5 miles, 8+ km) Green that starts at the top of the Burfield and Crystal Chairlifts and runs down between the Sunburst and Sundance areas.  It ends at the bottom of the Sunburst Express Chairlift.

tags.name: 7 Mile Road
tags.description: 7 Mile Road is a long, winding Black ungroomed cat track that starts at the bottom of Westsyde (Blue) and curves down the backside of the Lower Burfield Area to end on Expo (Double Black) just above the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Cruiser
tags.description: Cruiser is a long, wide Blue that starts at the top of the Sunburst Express Chairlift, runs down the frontside parallel to Exhibition (Blue) and ends on Connector (Green) just above the bottom of the Sunburst Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Exhibition
tags.description: Exhibition is a long, wide Blue that starts at the top of the Sunburst Express Chairlift, runs down the frontside parallel to the chair and ends at the Sunburst Express Chairlift base.

tags.name: Munro Ridge
tags.description: Munro Ridge is a long Blue that starts at the top of the Sunburst Express Chairlift, runs down the West side of the Sunburst area and ends on the Burfield Outrun (Green) which leads down to the Burfield Chairlift base area.

tags.name: Expo
tags.description: Expo is a steep, bumpy, difficult Double Black that starts on the right side of Highway 22 (Black), passes the Burfield Mid Station, curves under the chairlift line and then curves back down to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.
Roller Coaster is a steep Black mogul run.  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Expo (Double Black) and ends down on 7 Mile Road (Black).

tags.name: Roller Coaster
tags.description: Roller Coaster is a steep Black mogul run.  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Expo (Double Black) and ends down on 7 Mile Road (Black).

tags.name: Back in Time
tags.description: Back in Time is a long, narrow Blue that curves down the North side of Mount Morrisey.  It starts at the top of the Morrisey Express Chairlift and runs down to Sun Peaks Road.  You can cross the road to get to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Blazer
tags.description: Blazer is a steep Blue that runs down from the left side (looking downhill) of Munro Ridge (Blue) and ends at the bottom of the hill on Connector (Green).

tags.name: Burfield Outrun
tags.description: The Burfield Outrun is a long, narrow Green that starts on 5 Mile (Green), cuts across the front of the Sunburst area and then runs down to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Challenger
tags.description: Challenger is a bumpy, steep, wide challenging Double Black mogul run.  It starts on Highway 22 (Black), crosses Crystal Cat Track (Green) and runs down to end on Munro Ridge (Blue).  This runs starts narrow, gets wide and ends narrow.

tags.name: Hi-Voltage
tags.description: High Voltage is a short, steep, difficult Black that continues Roller Coaster (Black) past 7 Mile Road (Black).   It starts at 7 Mile Road and ends down at the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Tighten Yer Boots
tags.description: Tighten Yer Boots is a narrow, bumpy Black that runs from Munro Ridge (Blue) down to end on Burfield Outrun (Green).

tags.name: Burfield Return
tags.description: Burfield Return is a narrow Green path that starts at the end of Fairways Ski-Back (Green), runs behind homes and ends on Back in Time (Blue).   Back in Time leads then down to the road crossing to get to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Blue Line
tags.description: Blue Line is a steep, groomed Blue that runs down the front of the Crystal Bowl.  It starts on 5 Mile (Green) just below the top of the Crystal Chairlift and runs down to the chairlift base.

tags.name: Crystal Bowl
tags.description: The Crystal Bowl is the ungroomed, open alpine Black bowl area that sits between Crystal Run (Green) on the West and Blue Line (Blue) on the East.

tags.name: Crystal Run
tags.description: Crystal Run is a groomed Blue that cuts across the top and then down into Crystal Bowl. It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of 5 Mile (Green) and ends down on Blue Line (Blue).

tags.name: Highway 22A
tags.description: Highway 22A is short, steep Black that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Highway 22 (Black) and curves over to end on Crystal Run (Blue).

tags.name: Ralph's Reach
tags.description: Ralph’s Reach is a open alpine Black that curves through the small bowl between Highway 22A (Black) above and Highway 22 (Black) below.   As it enters the treeline, it enters the Crystal Glades area (Black).

tags.name: Highway 22
tags.description: Highway 22 is a steep Black that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Crystal Run (Blue), curves around the right side of the Crystal Bowl and ends down at the Crystal Cat Track (Green) which then leads to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: Round-a-Bout
tags.description: Round-a-bout is a narrow Blue catrack that runs from the bottom of Westsyde (Blue) over to the Burfield Chairlift Mid Station.

tags.name: Mid-Mountain
tags.description: Mid Mountain is Black Glade run that curves through the trees above Round-a-bout (Blue).  Access to the top of Mid Mountain is via a short hike up from the Mid Mountain Cat Track.

tags.name: Mid-Mountain Cat Track
tags.description: The Mid Mountain Cat Track (Blue) that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Highway 22 (Black), crosses Nose of the Chief (Blue) and then curves through the trees below ending on Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Juniper Ridge
tags.description: Juniper Ridge is a Black that runs across the top of the ridge above Crystal Bowl and then curves down to end on Round-a-bout (Black).  This starts near the top of the Burfield Chairlift and provides access to several Blacks that go down either side of th

tags.name: Kookamungas
tags.description: Kookamungas is a short, steep, gladed Double Black that starts on Juniper Ridge (Black), runs down the back of the summit and ends on Westsyde (Blue).

tags.name: Sunnyside
tags.description: Sunnyside, similar to Backdoor (Black), is a Black alpine run that starts from Juniper Ridge (Black) and runs down to end on Westsyde (Blue).

tags.name: Toilet Bowl
tags.description: Toilet Bowl is a steep, bumpy Black that starts on Juniper Ridge (Black) and runs down to end on Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Chief
tags.description: The Chief is a short, steep, open alpine Black that runs diagonally down the frontside of the ridge above Crystal Bowl.  It starts on Juniper Ridge (Black), runs parallel to Crystal Run (Green) and ends at the top of Highway 22 (Black).

tags.name: Father Tom's
tags.description: Father Tom’s is a Black that runs through the trees above Round-a-bout (Blue).  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of the Nose of the Chief (Black) and ends on Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Westsyde
tags.description: Westsyde is a Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of 5 Mile (Green) near the top of the Crystal Chairlift, curves down behind the summit and runs down to the top of Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Toilet Bowl
tags.description: Toilet Bowl is a steep, bumpy Black that starts on Juniper Ridge (Black) and runs down to end on Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Sunnyside West
tags.description: Sunnyside, similar to Backdoor (Black), is a bumpy Black alpine run that starts from Juniper Ridge (Black) and runs down to end on Westsyde (Blue).

tags.name: Nose of the Chief
tags.description: The Nose of the Chief starts on Juniper Ridge, runs parallel to the Chief Shoulder (Black) but then curves to the left ending down on Highway 22 (Blue).

tags.name: Chief Shoulder
tags.description: Similar to the Chief, the Chief Shoulder is a steep, open alpine Black that runs diagonally down the frontside of the ridge above Crystal Bowl.  It starts on Juniper Ridge (Black), runs parallel to the Chief (Black) and ends on Highway 22 (Black).

tags.name: Father Tom's
tags.description: Father Tom’s is a Black that runs through the trees above Round-a-bout (Blue).  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of the Nose of the Chief (Black) and ends on Round-a-bout (Blue).

tags.name: Mid-Mountain Hike
tags.description: Mid Mountain is Black Glade run that curves through the trees above Round-a-bout (Blue).  Access to the top of Mid Mountain is via a short hike up from the Mid Mountain Cat Track.

tags.name: Alley
tags.description: The Alley is a narrow Blue that allows skiers to exit out of the bottom of the Crystal area into the frontside Blue runs of the Sunburst area.  It starts at the bottom of the Crystal Chair and ends on Exhibition (Blue).

tags.name: Bluff
tags.description: Bluff is another one of the steep, bumpy Black mogul runs down the East side of the Sunburst area.  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Distributor (Blue) and ends on 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Crystal Lane
tags.description: Crystal Lane is a short Green that runs from the top of the Sunburst Express and Elevation Chairlifts over to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: Distributor
tags.description: Distributor is a Blue that starts near the top of the Sunburst Express & Elevation Chairlifts, runs down parallel to the chairlift and ends on Exhibition (Blue) at the top of Broadway (Black).

tags.name: East Bushwacker
tags.description: East Bushwacker is an ungroomed mogul run that initially branches off of Blue Line (Blue) on the East before crossing Lunch Time (Blue) into a larger mogul area before merging onto Crystal Lane (Green).

tags.name: Sting
tags.description: Sting is a steep, bumpy Black that starts on Exhibition (Blue), crosses Distributor (Blue) and ends on 5 Mile (Green).   Although sometimes ungroomed and bumpy, Sting is often groomed and can be a wonderful Black to carve down

tags.name: West Bushwacker
tags.description: West Bushwacker is steep, bumpy Blue that is the easier of the 2 Bushwacker runs next to the Crystal Chairlift.  It starts from Lunch Time (Blue) and ends at the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: Lunch Time
tags.description: Lunch Time is a narrow Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Blueline (Blue), cuts across the top of the Bushwacker runs and then heads down to the Sunburst Lodge area.

tags.name: Crystal Cat Track
tags.description: The Crystal Cat Track provides a route over from the Burfield Chairlift Mid Station to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.   NOTE:  This run has an uphill slope that will require some walking / skating to get over.

tags.name: Freddy's Nightmare
tags.description: Freddy’s Nightmare is a steep, bumpy Double Black glade run that starts on Crystal Cat Track (Green) next to the entrance to Expo and runs down to end on Challenger (Double Black).

tags.name: Hot Shot
tags.description: Hot Shot is a short, bumpy, ungroomed below that runs down parallel to the Crystal Chairlift.  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Lunch Time (Blue) and down to the bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Cruiser Glades
tags.description: The Cruiser Glades lades can be found between Blazer (Blue) and Cruiser (Blue) on the East side of the Sunburst area.   Locals also call these glades “Bruiser” (half Blazer, half Cruiser).

tags.name: Bushwacker Galdes
tags.description: The Bushwacker Glades are located between Lunch Time (Blue) and East Bushwacker (Black).

tags.name: Challenger Glades
tags.description: The Challenger Glades are a small area of difficult, tight Double Black glades on the right side (looking downhill) of Challenger (Double Black).

tags.name: Quick Shot
tags.description: Quick Shot is a short run that runs down beneath the Crystal Chairlift.  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Lunch Time (Blue) and down to the bottom of the chairlift between Hot Shot and West Bushwacker.

tags.name: Crystal Glades
tags.description: The Crystal Glades are located on either side of the lower end of the Crystal Run (Black) as it enters the tree line.

tags.name: Crystal Glades
tags.description: The Crystal Glades are located on either side of the lower end of the Crystal Run (Black) as it enters the tree line.

tags.name: Trans Canada
tags.description: Trans Canada is a short Blue that runs from the left side (looking downhill) of Cruiser near the top of the Sundance Express and Elevation Chairlifts over to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: 5 Mile
tags.description: 5 Mile is a long (5 miles, 8+ km) Green that starts at the top of the Burfield and Crystal Chairlifts and runs down between the Sunburst and Sundance areas. It ends at the bottom of the Sunburst Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Last Chance
tags.description: Last Chance is a short, ungroomed Blue that cuts the one of the corners of 5 Mile (Green), starting on 5 Mile and then ending on it further down the hill.

tags.name: Back Door
tags.description: Back Door is a short, steep, bumpy Black that starts on Juniper Ridge (Black), runs down the back of the summit and ends on Westsyde (Blue).

tags.name: Rice Bowl
tags.description: Rice Bowl is small, bumpy Black Bowl just below 5 Mile (Green) and ending on Spillway (Black).

tags.name: Pink Flamingos
tags.description: Pink Flamingos is a short, bumpy Black glade run through the trees just above Last Chance (Blue).  It starts on 5 Mile (Green), runs parallel to Last Chance and ends on 5 Mile.

tags.name: The Goat
tags.description: Jackrabbit - Similar to Kookamungas, Jackrabbit is a short, steep, bumpy Double Black that starts on Juniper Ridge (Black), runs down the back of the summit and ends on Westsyde (Blue).

tags.name: Gil's Cat Track
tags.description: Gil’s Cat Track is a Black run that snakes down a gully that runs down the bottom middle of the Gil’s area.  It starts in the middle upper East side of Gils and runs down to end on The Other Way (Blue).

tags.name: White Rabbit
tags.description: White Rabbit is a short, steep, bumpy Black that runs from 5 Mile (Green) down to Gil’s Cat Track (Blue) which then joins up again with 5 Mile lower down the mountain.

tags.name: Main Face
tags.description: Main Face is the “main face” in the center of Gil’s area.   You can access it at the top from Gil’s Hike and it runs down through the trees at the bottom to end on Gil’s Cat Track (Black).

tags.name: Easy Out
tags.description: Easy Out is the first glade accessible along Gil’s Hike.  It starts on Gil’s Hike and end’s down on The Other Way (Blue).   It has an “easy out” path at the bottom that follows a gully down to The Other Way.

tags.name: Rollers
tags.description: Roller’s is the 2nd last glade area accessible from Gil’s Hike before it ends at the top of Offset (Double Black).  Roller’s starts below Gil’s Hike, goes over a couple of small ridges (rollers) and ends down near the top of Gil’s Cat Track (Black).

tags.name: Skunk Hike
tags.description: Skunk Hike is a short uphill boot hike that starts on the left side of Gil's Hike.  It takes you to the top of the Skunk Glades that are above Gil's Hike.

tags.name: Skunk Glades
tags.description: Skunk Glades is a short area of Black glades above Gil's Hike.  Access at the top is via the Skunk Hike and this area ends on Gil's Hike.

tags.name: Inner Gil's
tags.description: Inner Gil’s is a Black Glade area on the West side of Gil’s area.  It is accessible at the top from Gil’s Traverse and has several exits down onto 5 Mile (Green) and The Other Way (Blue).

tags.name: Hat Trick
tags.description: Hat Trick is one of the bumpy, steep Black runs that come down the face below Blue Line (Blue).  It starts on Blue Line and then curves down to the right to end on Crystal Lane (Green) which leads down to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: Green Door
tags.description: Green Door is a short, steep, bumpy Double Black glade run that goes parallel to the Chute (Double Black).  It starts next to the entrance to the Chute and then ends on a service road that feeds back into the Chute

tags.name: Chillway Glades
tags.description: The Chillway Glades are located between the Chute (Black) and Spillway (Black).

tags.name: Cahilty
tags.description: Cahilty is a shorter, wide Green that runs from the top of the Sunburst Express and Elevation Chairlifts down to connect with 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Coquihalla
tags.description: Coquihalla is a short Black that starts near the top of the Sunburst Express Chair and ends on Cariboo (Blue).    Coquihalla also has a branch that goes left and ends on OSV (Blue).

tags.name: Crystal Lane
tags.description: Crystal Lane is a short Green that runs from the top of the Sunburst Express and Elevation Chairlifts over to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: Cariboo
tags.description: Cariboo is the longest of the steep, bumpy Black runs on the East side of the Sunburst area.   It starts on the side of Exhibition (Blue) and runs down to end on 5 Mile (Green) just above the bottom of the Elevation Chair.

tags.name: Chute
tags.description: The Chute is a steep, bumpy, difficult Double Black run that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Blue Line (Blue) and runs down to to Cahilty (Green).

tags.name: Headwalls
tags.description: Headwalls is the most well known of the 3 bumpy, steep Black runs coming down the slope below Blue Line (Blue).   Similar to Hat Trick, it starts on Blue Line and then curves down to the right to end on Crystal Lane (Green).

tags.name: OSV
tags.description: OSV is a steeper Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Cahilty (Blue) and runs down to 5 Mile (Green) near the base of the Elevation Chairlift.  This run is used for the racing and is often closed off to the public.

tags.name: Sacred Line
tags.description: Sacred Line is the middle of the 3 steep, bumpy black runs down the front of the slope below Blue Line (Blue).  It starts on Blue Line and ends on Crystal Lane (Green) which leads down to the bottom of the Crystal Chairlift.

tags.name: The Other Way
tags.description: The Other Way is a Blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of 5 Mile (Green) and runs over to connect with Homesteader (Green).

tags.name: Hully Gully
tags.description: Hully Gully is a very short Blue that runs down a gully on the right side (looking downhill) at the bottom of Cahilty (Green) and beside 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Coquihalla
tags.description: Coquihalla is a short Black that starts near the top of the Sunburst Express Chair and ends on Cariboo (Blue).    Coquihalla also has a branch that goes left and ends on OSV (Blue).

tags.name: Boundary Road
tags.description: Boundary Road is a Blue run that cuts across the bottom of the Gil’s area at the edge of the the ski resort boundary.  It starts at the bottom of Offset (Double Black) and ends on The Other Way (Blue).

tags.name: Cahilty Glades
tags.description: The Cahilty Glades can be found between Cahilty (Green) and OSV (Blue) on the East side of the Sunburst area.

tags.name: Cariboo Glades
tags.description: The Cariboo Glades can be found between Cariboo (Black) and Bluff (Black) on the East side of the Sunburst area.

tags.name: Coquihalla Glades
tags.description: The Coquihalla Glades can be found between OSV (Blue) and Cariboo (Black) on the East side of the Sunburst area.

tags.name: To Other Way
tags.description: This short run allows skiers and boarders to get to the top of The Other Way (Blue) from Spillway (Black).

tags.name: Offset
tags.description: Offset is a steep, bumpy, ungroomed, off-piste Double Black that runs down the far East side of Gil’s area.   It starts at the end of Gil’s Hike and ends down on Boundary Road (Blue).

tags.name: Fairways Ski Back
tags.description: The Fairways Ski Back is a narrow Green that runs towards the Burfield area along the base of Mount Morrisey, parallel to Fairways Drive and ends on Mountain View Drive.

tags.name: Runaway Lane
tags.description: Runaway Lane is a short, narrow Blue that runs from Munro Ridge (Blue) down to end on Connector (Green).

tags.name: 5 Mile Road
tags.piste:name: Burfield Outrun
tags.description: The Burfield Outrun is a long, narrow Green that starts on 5 Mile (Green), cuts across the front of the Sunburst area and then runs down to the bottom of the Burfield Chairlift.

tags.name: Wringer
tags.description: Wringers is a short Black that starts on In Tatters (Double Black) and runs down to Fairways Ski Back (Green).

tags.name: 5 Mile Road
tags.piste:name: Connector
tags.description: Connector is a short Green that cuts across the bottom of the Sunburst area runs and goes down to the Sunburst Express Chair base area.

tags.name: Blazer Glades
tags.description: The Blazer Glades can be found between Blazer (Blue) and Runaway Lane (Blue) on the East side of the Sunburst area.

tags.name: Homesteader
tags.description: Homesteader is a long Green that runs down the West side of the Sundance area and ends at the Village base and the bottom of the Sundance Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Rambler
tags.description: Rambler is a Green that runs from the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift down the east side of the Sundance area and ends on Main Village (Green).  Main Village then continues down to the Village base and the bottom of the Sundance Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Agitator
tags.description: Agitator is a short, steep, bumpy Black that starts on Grand Return (Blue), runs parallel to Spin Cycle (Black) and ends on Home Run (Green).

tags.name: Cover Shot
tags.description: Cover Shot is a short, steep Black that starts on Spin Cycle (Black) runs parallel to it and ends again on Spin Cycle.

tags.name: Spin Cycle
tags.description: Spin Cycle is a short, bumpy Black that starts on Grand Return (Blue), crosses Home Run (Green) and ends down at the bottom of the Morrisey Platter Poma Lift.

tags.name: Sunbeam
tags.description: Sunbeam is a very short Green used for beginners.   It starts at the top of the Village Platter Poma Lift and ends at the bottom of the lift.

tags.name: Anticipation
tags.description: Anticipation is a narrow, flat Green that runs from the top of the Morrisey Platter Poma Lift to the bottom of the Morrisey Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Home Run
tags.description: Home Run is a narrow Green cat track that cuts across the middle of the West side of Mount Morrisey and provides an exit route towards the Village base.

tags.name: 5th Avenue
tags.description: 5th Avenue is one of several steep, bumpy Black mogul runs down the East side of the Sunburst area.   It starts at the bottom of Distributor (Blue) and ends on 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Broadway
tags.description: Broadway is a wide, steep Black run that starts at the bottom of Distributor (Black) / on the left side of Exhibition (Blue) and ends on 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Intimidator
tags.description: Intimidator is another one of on of the steep, bumpy Black mogul runs down the East side of the Sunburst area.   It starts at the bottom of Distributor (Blue) and ends on 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Shortcut
tags.description: Shortcut is a narrow Blue that cuts across several of the Black runs on the East side of the Sunburst area.   It starts on Broadway (Black) and runs down to end on 5 Mile (Green).

tags.name: Bluff Glades
tags.description: The Bluff Glades can be found between Bluff (Black) and Sting (Black) on the East side of the Sunburst area.  These glades are known as “Bling” to locals (half Bluff, half Sting).

tags.name: Tube Park Outer
tags.description: The Tube Time tube park is a short, fun tube park with 2 curving tracks with high berm sides.

tags.name: Tube Park Inner
tags.description: The Tube Time tube park is a short, fun tube park with 2 curving tracks with high berm sides.

tags.name: Three Bears Glades
tags.description: The Three Bears Glades is an area of glades on either side of the Three Bears run (Blue).  Key your eyes out for the stuffy bears that are hanging in a tree in this area (and give it its name).

tags.name: Three Bears
tags.description: Three Bears is a Blue that starts on the side of Sundance (Blue) at the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift,  runs through and provides access to the Three Bears Glades and then ends down on Rambler (Green).

tags.name: Grannie Greene's Glades
tags.description: The Grannie Greens Glades is an area of glade skiing between Grannie Greens (Blue) on the West and Sun Downer (Blue) in the East.

tags.name: Grannie Greene's
tags.description: Grannie Greens is a wider Blue that starts at the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift and then ends down on Homesteader (Green) further down the hill.

tags.name: Lone Fir Center
tags.description: Lone Fir Center is a narrower Blue that starts on Homesteader (Green) and then ends down on Homesteader again further down the hill.  There are numerous unmarked runs and paths between this run and its neighbor runs.

tags.name: Sun Catcher
tags.description: Suncatcher is a long Blue that starts at the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift, runs underneath the chairlift line, curves to the right and then ends down on Homesteader (Green) just near the bottom of the

tags.name: Sun Downer
tags.description: Sun Downer another of the wide, big “Sun” Blues that run down the front of the Sundance area.  It starts at the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift and runs down to end on Homesteader (Green).

tags.name: Sundance
tags.description: Sundance is a blue that runs down the front of the Sundance area.  It starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green) near the top of the Sundance Express Chairlift, runs down parallel to the chairlift and ends bottom of the chairlift.

tags.name: Sunshine
tags.description: Sunshine is a short blue that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Suncatcher (Blue) and runs down to end on Rambler (Blue).   This run is the location of the Sun Peaks Expert Terrain Park area.

tags.name: Lonesome Fir Glades
tags.description: The Lonesome Fir Glades is an area of pockets of glade skiing in the trees between Lone Fir West (Blue) and Lone Fir Center (Blue).

tags.name: Sunrise
tags.description: Sunrise is a shorter Blue that starts about 1/2 way down on the left side (looking downhill) of Sundance (Blue).  It ends on Rambler (Green) which then runs down to the base of the Sundance Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Mt. Morrisey Connector
tags.description: The Mt. Morrisey Connector is Green that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green), curves across the top of the East Village and ends on the East Village Ski Way (which then leads over to the bottom of the Orient Chairlift).

tags.name: Shiner
tags.description: Shiner is a short Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of I’Dunno and runs down to end on The Sticks (Green).

tags.name: East Village Skiway
tags.description: East Village Ski Way is a long Green that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green) and then curves across and down through the Orient Chairlift area. At the base of the Orient area Blue runs, East Village Ski Way splits off to P5.

tags.name: Orient Return
tags.description: Orient Return is a gentle green run that allows skiers on the East Village Ski Way to return to the base of the Orient and Morrisey chairs. The run also collects skiers from the bottoms of Kia Ora and Ausfahrt.

tags.name: Golf Course Run
tags.description: The Golf Course Run is an informal run used to access several residential properties

tags.name: East Village Skiway
tags.description: East Village Ski Way is a long Green that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green) and then curves across and down through the Orient Chairlift area. At the base of the Orient area Blue runs, East Village Ski Way splits off to P5.

tags.name: East Village Skiway
tags.description: East Village Ski Way is a long Green that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green) and then curves across and down through the Orient Chairlift area. At the base of the Orient area Blue runs, East Village Ski Way splits off to P5.

tags.name: Ça M'a Fait Plaisir
tags.description: Ça M'a Fait Plaisir is a steep Blue that starts on the East Village Ski Way (Green) and runs down to end on the Mt.Morrisey Connector (Blue).

tags.name: Attraverso
tags.description: Attraverso ("across" in Italian) is a short Blue that cuts across the Orient area from the left side of Carpe Diem (Blue) over to Chicamichi (Blue) and Ca M'a Fait Plaisir (Blue).

tags.name: Ausfahrt
tags.description: Ausfahrt ("exit" in German) is a steep Blue run that starts on the East Village Ski Way (Green) and then drops down to end on Orient Return.   There are steep glade areas on either side of this run.

tags.name: Bug Out Glades
tags.description: The Bug Out Glades is an area of Black glade skiing with larger trees, steep sections and other terrain challenges.   You can access these glades either from the left side (looking downhill) of Peak-a-boo (Black) or from Rambler (Green) above.

tags.name: Carpe Diem
tags.description: Carpe Diem is another steep Blue that starts on the East Village Ski Way (Green) and runs down to end on the Mt.Morrisey Connector (Blue).

tags.name: Chicamichi
tags.description: Chickamichi is a short Blue run with small glade areas on either side that starts on Ca M’a Fait Plaisir (Blue) and ends on Carpe Diem (Blue).

tags.name: Cześć
tags.description: Cześć is a steep Blue turn that starts at the top of the Orient Chairlift and ends on Orient Return (Green) which then runs to the Orient Chairlift base.  Similar to Ausfahrt (Blue), there are steep glade areas on either side of this run.

tags.name: East Village Ski Way
tags.description: East Village Ski Way is a long Green that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Rambler (Green) and then curves across and down through the Orient Chairlift area.  At the base of the Orient area Blue runs, East Village Ski Way splits in two.

tags.name: Fair Dinkum
tags.description: Fair Dinkum is another of the Orient area Blues that starts at the top of the Orient Chairlift and ends on the East Village Ski Way (which then runs to the Orient Chairlift base).

tags.name: Peak-a-boo
tags.description: Peak-a-boo is an ungroomed, bumpy Black run that starts on the left side (looking downhill) of the Three Bears run (Blue) and ends down on Rambler (Green).

tags.name: Hasta La Vista
tags.description: Hasta La Vista is another steep Blue that starts at the top of the Orient Chairlift, runs under the chairlift and ends on the East Village Ski Way (Blue) which then runs to the Orient Chairlift base.

tags.name: Main Village
tags.description: Main Village is a Green that starts at the top of the Orient Chairlift,  curves over towards the Sundance Chairlift area and then runs down to the Village base and the bottom of the Sundance Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Poikki
tags.description: Poikki ("across" in Finnish) is a short Blue that cuts across from Cześć (Blue) over to the bottom of Ausfahrt (Blue).

tags.name: Poikki
tags.description: Poikki ("across" in Finnish) is a short Blue that cuts across from Cześć (Blue) over to the bottom of Ausfahrt (Blue).

tags.name: Lone Fir West
tags.description: Lone Fir West (similar to its sibling Lone Fir Center) is a narrower Blue that starts on Homesteader (Green) and then ends down on Homesteader again further down the hill.

tags.name: Homesteader
tags.description: Homesteader is a long Green that runs down the West side of the Sundance area and ends at the Village base and the bottom of the Sundance Express Chairlift.

tags.name: Eldorado Gulley
tags.description: Expert unmarked trail off Eldorado. Somewhat flat gulley beginning into area with chute and cliff drop into a small bowl. Exit out through another gully onto Eldorado. Conditions can be marginal in early season

tags.name: Dirt Chute
tags.description: Expert unmarked trail Off the side of gowabunga, requires some flat tree traverse to find the chute, conditions can be marginal early season

tags.name: Dirt Gulley
tags.description: Expert unmarked trail. Exit gully from the caliper or gowabunga entrances, conditions can be marginal early season. Requires very short uphill hike out to get back on the main trail when the gulley flattens out.

tags.name: Tower 20 Trail
tags.description: Expert unmarked trail. Enter near tower 20 off the powder gulch lift. conditions can be marginal early season

tags.name: Bear Claw
tags.description: Old slackcountry trail from earlier resort seasons. No brush cutting done. Looks to be very marginal conditions with alot of small to medium growth on the slope
